name: Nessie
tagline: Sketches out a national dividend and the hard question of who pays for it
description: Big redistribution ideas usually collapse the moment someone asks how they would be funded. This one works through one with you: the floor everybody receives, how earned pay stacks on top of it, the mechanisms that raise the money, and where the plan would strain. It is a design partner, not a manifesto.
author: AlecSnelling
